description: Set what a reply to one of your emails says, when the word lists sorted it wrong: positive, negative, unknown, unsubscribe, out_of_office or auto_reply. Setting the class it already has records that it was right. Setting unsubscribe adds the recipient of the email it answers to the suppression list. Setting a person's class on an out_of_office or auto_reply stops the campaign for that lead and, when the workspace's Replies switch is on, ends that person's leads in your other campaigns that were added before the reply arrived (not for unsubscribe, which the suppression list already covers). Nothing here takes anyone off the suppression list or starts a campaign again. Answers 409 replyNotClassified for a message that is not a reply we sorted (mail that answers none of your emails, or arrived before replies were stored this way).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

replyClass.description: What the reply counts as: positive (interested), negative (not interested), unknown (replied, and the word lists cannot tell which way), unsubscribe (asked to stop), out_of_office or auto_reply. The class it already has records that the lists were right.

name: correct_reply_class
title: Correct a reply's class
